mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impact.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a positive supply shock that will boost productivity and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m/m and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX realizes negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the positive supply shock signal is triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, if accompanied by stable or falling consumer prices, signals a disinflationary labor market shock that will allow the Fed to ease policy and boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL does not rise
failure_condition: Fed funds rate rises > 25bp in the month following the signal trigger, indicating the Fed is not shifting to an easing bias.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts, coupled with a rise in consumer sentiment, signals a positive demand shock that will boost economic growth and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% y/y and RSAFS rises > 2% m/m
failure_condition: Leading economic indicators (e.g., yield curve slope, manufacturing PMI) turn negative during the signal period, indicating an impending growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in consumer prices, signals a positive real rates shock that will boost financial conditions and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 50bp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL does not rise
failure_condition: Real yields (nominal yields minus expected inflation) do not rise during the signal period, indicating the rate hike is not tightening financial conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment, if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a negative labor market shock that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100k in a month and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp
failure_condition: Consumer confidence rises sharply during the signal period, indicating the labor market shock is not negatively impacting household spending.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in industrial production, if accompanied by a rise in consumer prices, signals a negative supply shock that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 1% m/m and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% m/m
failure_condition: The ISM manufacturing PMI rises during the signal period, indicating the supply shock is not negatively impacting industrial activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP, if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a negative growth shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines > 1% q/q and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Leading indicators of global growth (e.g., copper prices, Asian export volumes) rise during the signal period, indicating the growth shock is not broad-based.
